name: Dr. Keith G.
title: Founder, Freedom Note Capital LLC
paragraphs: Freedom Note Capital was founded to hold and manage mortgage notes as part of a diversified long-term investment portfolio.

Dr. Keith G. is a practicing physician and real estate investor who began investing in mortgage notes after looking for ways to generate portfolio income without adding additional rental property management responsibilities.

Freedom Note Capital primarily focuses on performing residential mortgage notes with established payment histories, meaningful collateral protection, and characteristics suitable for long-term ownership.
